adds.name: label dimension
adds.meaning: The dimension $h^3=10^6$ of the label space of a fixed network, and the factor by which one recursive call multiplies the chunk parameter.

adds.name: wire count
adds.meaning: The number of wires (roles) of a fixed network, equal to the number of role streams a call is split into.

adds.name: total edge rank
adds.meaning: The sum over the edges of a fixed network of the rank of the edge change, i.e. the number of smaller calls in one invocation.

adds.name: saving exponent
adds.meaning: The fixed exponent $2^{-182}$ by which the logarithmic factor is reduced.

adds.name: stored volume
adds.meaning: The number of stored data bits of the array being processed.

adds.name: precision
adds.meaning: The number of fractional bits of the fixed-point grid, $p=6\lceil\log_2n\rceil$.

adds.name: axis count
adds.meaning: The number of power-of-two axes (address chunks), of order $p^{\epsilon}$.

adds.name: chunk bits
adds.meaning: The number of bits in each address chunk, $K=\lfloor d^c\rfloor$.

adds.name: record length
adds.meaning: The number of complex coefficients $r=2^\ell$ in a polynomial record modulo $y^r+1$.

adds.name: box size
adds.meaning: The number $\prod_it_i$ of entries in the padded power-of-two box, with $Tp=\Theta(n)$.

adds.name: log record length
adds.meaning: The binary logarithm $\log_2r$.

adds.name: power-of-two length
adds.meaning: The length $r/2$ or $r$ of axis $i$ in the padded box.

adds.name: prime length
adds.meaning: The distinct odd prime length of axis $i$, just below $t_i$.

adds.name: interchange exponent
adds.meaning: The fixed exponent $1-2^{-50}$ in the interchange cost $O(Vu^\tau)$.

adds.name: layer exponent
adds.meaning: The fixed exponent $1-2^{-54}$ in the butterfly layer cost $O(Vd^{\lambda'})$.
